content_data.meeting_title: Robotics Vision System Architecture Review and Sprint Planning
agenda_items: Plan integration testing strategy for multi-robot coordination framework
Address performance bottlenecks in real-time object detection module
Evaluate cloud infrastructure requirements for edge deployment across European facilities
key_decisions: Adopt YOLOv8 architecture for improved detection accuracy while maintaining real-time performance requirements
Implement hybrid edge-cloud architecture with primary processing on-device and telemetry aggregation in Azure
Allocate additional GPU resources to development environment for parallel model training experiments
Postpone full ROS2 migration by 6 weeks to allow for comprehensive testing of critical safety systems
